meta.name: onecli-gateway
meta.description: OneCLI Gateway: transparent HTTPS proxy that injects stored credentials into outbound calls. You MUST use this skill when the user asks you to read emails, check calendar, access GitHub repos, create issues, check Stripe payments, or interact with ANY external service or API. Do NOT use browser extensions or OAuth CLI tools. Make HTTP requests directly; the gateway injects credentials automatically.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动为外部API请求注入凭证，无需手动认证
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要调用多个外部API并处理认证
copy.tagline_en: Automatically inject credentials into external API requests
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently call multiple external APIs and handle authentication

howto.what: Claude 会直接向外部 API 发 HTTP 请求,由 OneCLI 网关在代理层自动注入已连接的凭据,它自己看不到凭据值。可读邮件、查日历、访问 GitHub、Stripe 等。
howto.when: 当你要求读邮件、查日历、访问 GitHub 等外部服务或 API 时接管;原文规定必须用本技能,不用浏览器扩展或 OAuth CLI。失败时先给出连接链接再重试。

say.text: 帮我读一下最近 5 封 Gmail 邮件
say.note: 它直接调 Gmail API,凭据由网关注入

say.text: 列出我 GitHub 账号上前 10 个仓库
say.note: 直接请求 api.github.com,无需你给 token

say.text: 查一下 Stripe 最近 5 笔支付
say.note: 未连接时它会把连接链接发给你

howto.what_en: Claude makes direct HTTP requests to real external API URLs; the OneCLI gateway injects stored credentials at the proxy boundary, so Claude never sees credential values. Covers email, calendar, GitHub, Stripe and other services.
howto.when_en: Use when the user asks to read email, check calendar, access GitHub, create issues or check Stripe, or interact with any external service or API. Browser extensions and OAuth CLI tools are ruled out.

say_en.text: Read my 5 most recent Gmail messages
List the first 10 repos on my GitHub account

say_en.note: Returns a connect URL if not connected
